vendor_name.label: Vendor Name
vendor_name.ai_match_reasoning: Debora Debby Wage is an individual property owner, not a company — the agreement calls her "the PARTNER" (MITRA), not a Lessor. Both invoices are issued in her personal name, which is why they carry no Faktur Pajak.

lessor_npwp.label: Vendor NPWP
lessor_npwp.ai_match_reasoning: Not stated. The source tracker records a NIK (National Identity Number) 3276024502830010 instead, consistent with an individual rather than a registered taxable business (non-PKP).

rent_basis_type.label: Rent Basis Type
rent_basis_type.ai_match_reasoning: Revenue Share, flat 15% of Net Sales Value for all 5 years. There is no fixed rent, so Base Rent, Monthly Rent, Total Contract Value and No. of Installments are all blank in the source BY DESIGN, not missing.

base_rent_monthly_excl_tax.label: Base Rent (Excl Tax) Monthly
base_rent_monthly_excl_tax.ai_match_reasoning: No fixed rent exists under a revenue-share agreement — blank in the source by design.

monthly_rent_incl_tax.label: Monthly Rent incl. Tax (Cond.)
monthly_rent_incl_tax.ai_match_reasoning: No fixed rent exists under a revenue-share agreement — blank in the source by design.

total_contract_value.label: Total Contract Value, Lumpsum
total_contract_value.ai_match_reasoning: Not computable: the total depends on 5 years of future sales. Do not enter the Rp211,670,000 Investment Cost here — that is paid by the PARTNER TO BBB for outlet assets, the opposite direction, and is tracked as a one-time payment instead.

no_of_installments.label: No. of Installments
no_of_installments.ai_match_reasoning: Not a fixed-installment contract. The derived schedule instead carries 60 monthly revenue-share periods plus 60 monthly IPL fee rows.

base_fee.label: Monthly Rent
base_fee.ai_match_reasoning: No fixed monthly rent to fall back on — the reference amount is computed as Revenue Share % x Net Sales instead.

revenue_share_pct.label: Revenue Share (%)
revenue_share_pct.ai_match_reasoning: The only rent driver this contract has: 15% of Net Sales Value, flat across all five years. Net Sales Value is the sales report's own Sales (Ex. PB1) less Biaya Ojol and Discount.

revenue_threshold.label: Revenue Share Threshold Amount
revenue_threshold.ai_match_reasoning: No minimum threshold — 15% applies from Rp0 of Net Sales Value.

rent_billing_day.label: Rent Billing Day
rent_billing_day.ai_match_reasoning: No fixed billing day. BBB sends the monthly sales report by the 10th of the following month, the PARTNER then invoices, and BBB pays within 14 working days of receiving a complete invoice.

security_deposit.label: Security Deposit
security_deposit.ai_match_reasoning: No landlord-style deposit exists under this Cooperation Agreement structure.

utilities_billing.label: Utilities Billing
utilities_billing.ai_match_reasoning: BBB pays electricity, water, cleaning and maintenance directly. Separately the PARTNER levies a FLAT IPL fee of Rp4,000,000/month (security, cleanliness, waste) plus Rp11,000,000/month (electricity and water) = Rp15,000,000/month excl. VAT, explicitly in lieu of metered utility billing. That is why the utility invoice is matched against the IPL schedule and NOT treated as a billed-on-actuals charge.

wht_applicable.label: WHT Applicable
wht_applicable.ai_match_reasoning: Recorded as "Not stated" in the source tracker; shown as NA. In practice PPh IS withheld — the utility invoice deducts 10% ("Pemotongan PPH") on both of its lines.

wht_rate_pct.label: WHT Rate (%)
wht_rate_pct.ai_match_reasoning: Recorded as "Not stated" in the source tracker; shown as NA. The utility invoice implies 10% (Rp1,222,222 on Rp12,222,222), but no rate is printed anywhere and the contract only says "per prevailing tax regulations".

computed_status.label: Computed Status
computed_status.ai_match_reasoning: Active — signed 3-Mar-2026, term 12-Mar-2026 to 11-Mar-2031, both signature blocks executed.

lessor_bank_account_name.label: Bank Account Name
lessor_bank_account_name.ai_match_reasoning: Not in the tracker's own Field 46, but printed identically on both invoices and in the agreement's payment article: MANDIRI 1270000055283, DEBORA DEBBY WAGE.
